name: Fausta_Luperci
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing from non-magical weapons
notes: CR 10 divine champion. AC 18. HP 145. Multiattack: 3 spear attacks. Spear +9 (1d8+5 piercing + 1d6 radiant). Frozen Advance: difficult terrain does not slow her; DC 15 Con save when she enters within 5ft or reduce speed by 10. Legendary Defiance 1/round: on drop below 50HP gain 20 temp HP and auto-succeed one save. Mars calls Enough after 10 rounds or 0 HP.
gm_notes: Session 5 divine champion. She held the line at the Frozen Rhine. She died alone. She serves Mars. History DC 14 passive: player knows the battle was real, she was real. She respects endurance and discipline — not tricks. Feints have no effect. She rotates targets after 2 rounds vs. same character. Fausta kneels on defeat; Mars inclines his head. Sand drinks her form.
